text: Fixed in errors.go: `Error` (the value type) implements `error`, but `Unwrap` was only defined on `*Error`, so a value `Error` could not be unwrapped by errors.Is/As/Unwrap. Unwrap now has a value receiver (pointers still work). Full test suite is green.

Fixed in response_writer.go: `WriteHeader` warned "Wanted to override status code X with Y" but then actually overwrote `w.status` after the header was already written, so `Status()` disagreed with what was sent. It now returns after the warning. Suite green.
Still hunting the params issue in tree.go (getValue/addRoute). Probes show params are correct for the common route shapes; narrowing down the uncovered path.

Fixed in tree.go: in findCaseInsensitivePathRec the wildcard child was taken as children[0]; the wildcard child is kept at the END of the child slice, so with multiple children plus a wildcard it descended into a static node and panicked ("invalid node type"). Now uses children[len(children)-1]; the panic is gone and the whole suite is green.

Fixed in context.go: NegotiateFormat indexed offer[i] while looping over len(accepted), so an offer shorter than the accepted media type panicked with index out of range. The loop is now bounded by both lengths. Suite green.
Still working on the attachment/escaping issue in context.go (FileAttachment/isASCII paths look right for both ASCII and non-ASCII names; checking the escaping of the ASCII filename).

Status: 4 of your 6 bugs are fixed and the full suite is green (tree.go case-insensitive wildcard child, context.go NegotiateFormat panic, response_writer.go status override, errors.go Unwrap receiver). Still open: the tree.go params issue (#3) and the context.go attachment escaping (#6) — I have not yet found the exact code path for those two.

Status: still open. FileAttachment's two branches and isASCII are each verified correct by the existing tests, so the escaping defect must be in an input class those tests don't cover; I'm still pinning it down.
